title: Sauce Suprême
description: Chicken velouté enriched with cream and finished with butter: silky, rich, and especially good with chicken or pork.
ingredients: 500 mL prepared chicken velouté (see Chicken Velouté)
5 mL fresh lemon juice (1 teaspoon), or to taste
Salt and ground white pepper, to taste
steps: Bring the velouté to a gentle simmer in a heavy saucepan. Add 100 mL of the cream.
Simmer gently for 10–15 minutes, stirring frequently, until the sauce coats the back of a spoon. Do not reduce it to a paste.
Stir in the remaining 50 mL cream and warm through. If too thick, loosen with a small splash of unsalted chicken stock or water.
Remove from the heat and whisk in the cold butter a few cubes at a time.
Add the lemon juice gradually, then season with salt and white pepper. Strain if desired and serve warm.
notes: Pair with poached or roasted chicken, pork tenderloin, asparagus, or mushrooms. The lemon should brighten the sauce without making it taste lemony. This is a streamlined cream-and-butter version; classical versions may include mushroom cooking liquor. Timing assumes the velouté is already made. Once finished with butter, avoid a hard boil.
